title: Let Vision-Language Models Generate Images through Their Representations
abstract: arXiv:2611.31237v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Recent unified multimodal models aim to combine visual understanding and generation within a single model, yet effectively integrating the two capabilities remains challenging. Leveraging pretrained vision-language models offers a way to build on already learned multimodal knowledge, but making this knowledge effectively accessible to visual generation remains nontrivial. We find that a central challenge lies in the heterogeneous visual representations used for understanding and generation. To address this challenge, we introduce Integral, which converts a pretrained vision-language model into a unified multimodal model by constructing a shared visual representation space across the two capabilities. Integral implements this design through two complementary components. translated_title: 让视觉-语言模型通过其自身表示生成图像
translated_abstract: 近期的统一多模态模型旨在将视觉理解与图像生成结合到单一模型中，然而如何有效整合这两种能力仍然充满挑战。利用预训练的视觉-语言模型为构建模型提供了一条继承已有多模态知识的途径，但要让这些知识有效服务于视觉生成并非易事。我们发现，核心挑战在于理解与生成任务所使用的视觉表示存在异构性。为应对这一挑战，我们提出 Integral，通过在两种能力之间构建共享的视觉表示空间，将预训练的视觉-语言模型转化为统一的多模态模型。Integral 通过两个互补的组件实现这一设计：Abstraction Fusion 通过聚合冻结视觉编码器的层次化表示来构建共享视觉 token，而 Block-wise MoT 则引入一种轻量级的……
tldr: 提出 Integral 框架，通过 Abstraction Fusion 与 Block-wise MoT 两个组件构建理解与生成之间共享的视觉表示空间，从而将预训练视觉-语言模型转化为统一的图像理解与生成多模态模型。
en_tdlr: Integral converts a pretrained vision-language model into a unified multimodal model by constructing a shared visual representation space between understanding and generation, via Abstraction Fusion and a lightweight Block-wise MoT.
